title: A hand-created work order has an empty Maintenance schedule column
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with Create and edit work orders and reporting access, on the build under test.
  2. Work orders are being created from due services (an enrolled asset has a due service, e.g. 'ZZAUTOTEST Truck 12').
custom_steps:
1. Create a work order by hand (not from a due service).
  2. Open the Work Orders list and read its Maintenance schedule column.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The Maintenance schedule column is empty for a work order with no maintenance origin.
  • A work order created by hand carries no origin and is not inferred into one.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10577 (S22, Origin reporting); Chunk 2 MR spec (Confluence 897679389), Part 3 / S22; read 2 Oct 2026. Source-verified 2 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S22-R3: “The column will be empty for work orders with no maintenance origin”
  • S22-N1: “A work order created by hand carries no origin and is not inferred into one”
